notes: Countywide separately elected Sheriff. The current Sheriff's Office homepage and elected-official directory identify Marian Brown. Official biography pages disagree on whether she was sworn in on January 1, 2018 or January 1, 2019; that historical-date conflict does not affect the current-holder field.

Countywide separately elected County Clerk. The official biography identifies John F. Warren and states that he was elected Dallas County Clerk in January 2007; current County Clerk payment instructions independently identify him.
Countywide separately elected District Clerk. The official biography identifies Felicia Pitre and states that she was elected November 6, 2014 and took office January 1, 2015.
Countywide separately elected Tax Assessor/Collector. The official biography identifies John R. Ames, CTA, and current 2026 County Auditor reports independently identify him as the officeholder.

Countywide separately elected County Treasurer. The official biography identifies Pauline Medrano and records her November 2022 reelection; current 2026 County Auditor reports independently identify her as the officeholder.
